description: This PHP class 'EmployeeGender' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField\Personal\Dto' represents an employee's gender, mapping integer gender codes to string labels ('Male', 'Female', 'Other'). It implements the 'Stringable' interface, providing a 'toString()' method to convert the gender code to its string representation.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for representing an employee's gender as a string based on internal integer codes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the gender with an integer or null value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the internal gender code to its corresponding string label.
